# fluss-go v0.1.0-beta.8

This prerelease corrects scan boundaries discovered during real application
integration with Apache Fluss 0.9.1 and strengthens the public-beta project
surface introduced after beta.7.

## Highlights

- Makes `fgo.AtOffset` and timestamp-resolved log scans honor their documented
  inclusive lower bound even when Fluss returns the complete containing batch.
- Applies the same trimming to row and Arrow batches from local and remote-log
  payloads before row limits and stopping offsets are counted.
- Keeps Arrow records, base offsets, and change vectors aligned after slicing,
  and prevents subsequent fetch offsets from moving backwards.
- Enforces `LIMIT_SCAN` limits for oversized KV, row, Arrow, and mixed-format
  responses and applies configured Arrow projections.
- Corrects stopping-offset completion across bucket resubscription and
  unsubscription operations.
- Adds public-beta security, support, contribution, conduct, and structured
  issue-reporting guidance.

## Upgrade notes

- No exported API changed in this release.
- Applications using explicit or timestamp-based log scans should upgrade to
  avoid processing records before the requested offset or consuming bounds
  with those records.
- All four optional adapter modules are published at beta.8 and require the
  beta.8 root module, so selecting an adapter directly also selects the scanner
  corrections.
- The compatibility target remains Apache Fluss `0.9.1-incubating` at commit
  `6bf969f71af8d6f9cc37383ab89ae46a58b0e227`.
- Use Go 1.25.12 or newer in the 1.25 series, or Go 1.26.5 or newer in the 1.26
  series.

See the [full changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md), the
[data-operations guide](../../docs/data-operations.md), the
[error-handling guide](../../docs/error-handling.md), and the
[release process](../../docs/releasing.md).

This is a pre-v1 release. Pin the root and adapter module versions and review
the changelog before upgrading.
